title: Square-bracket operations clubs
summary: This paper continues the investigation of the three square-bracket operations $[\cdot\cdot]$ from chapter 5 of \cite{Walks}. \ We say that a square-bracket operation $[\cdot\cdot]$ has the \emph{Ramsey club property} if for every club $C\subseteqω_{1}$, there is an uncountable subset $W$ $\subseteq ω_{1}$ such that $\left[ αβ\right] \in C$ for every $α,β\in W.$ \ The second author proved that the Proper Forcing Axiom\textsf{ }implies that all the square-bracket operations induced by Aronszajn trees have this property.
